proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ a h0
  simp only [Ideal.span_singleton_le_span_singleton, Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨h.1, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hb
    rcases h.2 rfl with hu | hu
    · exact Or.inl hu
    · right
      exact Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mpr (associated_mul_unit_left _ _ hu).symm
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    rintro x y rfl
    rcases h2 x (Dvd.intro _ rfl) with hx | hx
    · exact Or.inl hx
    · right
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := Ideal.span_singleton_eq_span_singleton.mp hx
      have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at h0
      rw [← mul_left_cancel₀ hx0 hu]
      exact u.isUnit
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] (a : A), a ≠ 0 → (Irreducible a ↔ (Ideal.span {a} ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ b : A, Ideal.span {a} ≤ Ideal.span {b} → Ideal.span {b} = ⊤ ∨ Ideal.span {b} = Ideal.span {a}))
